purpose: Teach: グローバリゼーション/投信/空母/プレーオフ/有線/セメント/プランニング/農水省
target_vocab: グローバリゼーション

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: グローバリゼーションの影響を分析しましょう
lines.en: Let's analyze the impact of globalization.
lines.style: Brisk, businesslike opening. Clear articulation on key word. Professional pace, forward momentum. No hesitation—this is the agenda.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。投信商品のリスクを丁寧にご説明します
lines.en: Yes. I'll explain the investment product risks carefully.
lines.style: Cooperative acknowledgment, slightly formal. Measured delivery showing attentiveness to the task. Steady, reassuring tone without being obsequious.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 空母型の大型販売拠点を作りましょう
lines.en: Let's establish a large-scale hub for sales operations.
lines.style: Directive, confident. Slight emphasis on the strategic idea. Deliberate pace. Authority without sharpness—this is her thinking aloud to a colleague.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。プレーオフ進出時のキャンペーンを準備します
lines.en: Yes. I'll prepare the campaign for our playoff push.
lines.style: Affirming with a note of understanding the scope. Steady, supportive. Shows he's tracking what she's directing and ready to execute.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: オフィスの有線LANを増設しましょう
lines.en: Let's expand the office network infrastructure.
lines.style: Direct assignment. Clean articulation. Practical pace. Matter-of-fact—this is a task item, not a suggestion.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。セメント施工業者の選定をします
lines.en: Yes. I'll coordinate the selection of contractors.
lines.style: Efficient confirmation. Slightly faster pace—he's integrating the instruction and moving forward. Professional, no resistance.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 来期プランニングの会議を設定しましょう
lines.en: Let's schedule the next planning meeting.
lines.style: Concluding directive. Slight settling in tone, as if wrapping up the list. Clear but not urgent. Sets the final item.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。農水省のホームページを定期確認します
lines.en: Yes. I'll monitor the ministry updates regularly.
lines.style: Closing affirmation. Calm, professional finality. The tone of someone checking off the last item. Steady and competent.
